title: Build a recurrent same-channel reference without transferring its recurrence
statement: For every weakly reversible finite reaction graph, sum positive unit circulations through cycles containing every reaction to obtain a_r>0 with complex flow balance. The mass-action reference with constants a_r has stationary nu(x)=exp(-d)/prod_i x_i!, lifted flux exp(-d)*a_r/(x-y_r)! and finite total stationary activity sum_r a_r. Its conditional closed-class chains are nonexplosive and positive recurrent. Any original positive rates have fixed channelwise factors m a_r<=kappa_r<=M a_r, but products of these factors along arbitrarily long excursions are uncontrolled and the invariant law may change. This standard reference construction does not prove recurrence of the original rates.
